title: Treasure2 Block Mining Fix
description: Makes Treasure2's blocks that should be minable with pickaxes actually minable with pickaxes
body:
![Logo](https://i.ibb.co/27grbvwW/logo-wide.png)
# Features:

Makes Treasure2's blocks that should be minable with pickaxes actually minable with pickaxes

# Requirements

- [Treasure2](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/treasure2)

# Donation

[https://ko-fi.com/lordddiamond](https://ko-fi.com/lordddiamond)

# Modpacks

Yeah, you **can** use it in your modpack! 😇

![Pickaxe mining block tag fix](https://i.ibb.co/23xgrRm1/Screen-1.png)
